facts.fact: Matin Libre reports Parakou has full cadastral coverage with 196,474 parcels registered in the national cadastre on the e-Foncier Bénin platform, with over 11,500 registration certificates (CEC) distributed by 1 September 2026.

Municipal officials say cadastral data updating continues and new e-Foncier Bénin functions for recasement attestations, mutation certificates and compulsions are to be developed, while the PPMEC project aims for a complete cadastre.
